name: Passive destination names + cleartext decode
summary: Phase 1 of the outbound-visibility program plus two backlog items, all merged to develop and reviewed via the swarm. Headline: passive DNS name resolution — a port-53 capture resolves egress IPs to the hostnames apps actually looked up, shown in the tree/zoom/inspect (honest about DoH/pre-existing-connection gaps), with a light-touch corroborated raw-IP concern nudge and cleartext HTTP decode (dechunk + gzip/deflate) in the inspector. Also: per-item quarantine undo + collector gaps carried in --from snapshots (#8), and an install.sh PREFIX hardening (#14). No new CLI flags.

required.title: Passive DNS destination names + cleartext decode (#3 Phase 1)
required.summary: internal/netname observer/cache/parser; generalized port-scoped /dev/bpf capture (OpenPortCapture, T-16); Endpoint.Name annotated pre-scoring; names in tree/zoom/inspect; light-touch corroborated raw-IP concern; DecodeCleartext dechunk+decompress + sensitive-header masking. egress->netname->inspect, cycle-free; decoupling + egress-only invariants held.

required.title: Per-item undo + collector gaps in --from snapshots (#8)
required.summary: scan --json emits a wrapped Snapshot {tool_version,gaps,assessments} so --from surfaces collector gaps (old bare arrays still load); u restores the selected finding via act.RestoreItem (whole-session restore stays in the CLI).

required.title: install.sh PREFIX hardening (#14)
required.summary: install.sh creates a custom PREFIX when absent; the curl|sh universal-binary path was already shipped.

deferred.title: Surface passive-DNS observer errors for RCA (T-17)
deferred.summary: A mid-session capture failure degrades destinations to IPs with no log line; can't stderr mid-alt-screen. Deferred to the --non-interactive logging mode, which has a file/stdout channel (Rule 16: no TUI-safe channel exists yet).
